mapper.sql: id, order_id, user_id, order_type, ticket_id, equipment_id, course_id, amount, status, payment_method, cancel_reason, create_time, end_time

o.id, o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_type AS orderType, o.ticket_id AS ticketId, o.equipment_id AS equipmentId, o.course_id AS courseId, CASE WHEN o.order_type = '雪票' THEN t.name WHEN o.order_type = '雪具租赁' THEN e.name WHEN o.order_type = '课程' THEN c.title ELSE '未知商品' END AS productName, o.amount, o.status, o.payment_method AS paymentMethod, o.cancel_reason AS cancelReason, u.name AS userName, u.phone AS userPhone, o.create_time AS createTime, o.end_time AS endTime
mapper.select: SELECT FROM orders o LEFT JOIN ticket t ON o.ticket_id = t.id LEFT JOIN equipment e ON o.equipment_id = e.id LEFT JOIN courses c ON o.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN user u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY o.create_time DESC

SELECT FROM orders o LEFT JOIN ticket t ON o.ticket_id = t.id LEFT JOIN equipment e ON o.equipment_id = e.id LEFT JOIN courses c ON o.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN user u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE o.id = #{id} AND o.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_id, user_id, order_type, ticket_id, equipment_id, course_id, amount, status, create_time) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{userId}, #{orderType}, #{ticketId}, #{equipmentId}, #{courseId}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{createTime})
